summary: **Software Engineer** with **9+ years of experience** building automation and cloud tooling in **Python**, **.NET**, and **JavaScript**. Currently accelerating **Azure sovereign cloud** and new region buildouts at Microsoft through deployment data analysis, automation, and cross-team optimization. Creator and maintainer of **AltWalker**, an open-source testing framework with **50K+ downloads**.

education.name: Babeş-Bolyai University, Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science

subsections.description: Accelerate **Azure sovereign cloud** and new region buildouts by analyzing deployment data to uncover automation gaps, bottlenecks, and recurring errors, reducing **buildout time**.
Automate manual buildout steps across **3 sovereign cloud environments** using **ARM** and **Bicep**, eliminating human error and making deployments repeatable.

Perform **root-cause analysis** on buildout failures and delays across new regions, identifying systemic issues such as dependency ordering, retries, and **manual operations**, and driving fixes that reduced **deployment failure rates**.
Partner with **20+ Azure engineering teams** to optimize their buildout workflows, turning analysis into prioritized, tracked improvements.

Build **Azure Data Explorer (KQL)** and **Power BI** dashboards and **pandas/NumPy** reports that track deployment status, automation progress, and standardization across buildouts and environments, driving **Infrastructure as Code** adoption across **Azure Core**.
Created and maintained **AltWalker**, an open-source **Model-Based Testing framework** for **Python** and **.NET/C#**, reaching **50K+ downloads** and adoption by **20+ organizations**.
Built and optimized **CI/CD pipelines** across **Jenkins**, **GitLab CI/CD**, and **GitHub Actions** for **5+ projects**, cutting deployment time by up to **30%**.
Built **Flask** and **MongoDB** REST APIs plus an **Ember.js** test-report dashboard, supporting automated reporting across **10+ projects/teams**.
Extended test automation tooling for **Unity** apps with **WebGL** support and **BrowserStack/BitBar** device-cloud integration, enabling automated testing across mobile and web.
Led **5** online Model-Based Testing workshops, training **100+** engineers through hands-on exercises.
Implemented **feature enhancements** and resolved **critical bugs** as part of an **agile development** team, contributing to 3 major product releases.
Collaborated through **code reviews** and **pair programming** with senior developers.
